reference.source: package/dist/antd.min.js; runtime CSS-in-JS; React 18.3.1; inherited global-token typography and color
reference.operation: Render public Empty API including URL/nodes/scalars/config/semantic/prefix/ref-compatible roots and Empty alias/algorithm themes; capture classes, declared slot effects and complete SVG paint/geometry
reference.nativeBoundary: Native default/simple aliases represent the source image constants. image=false removes its wrapper; image stays inert/decorative and responsive, footer keeps native flex/wrapping, focus recovery and named group remain native contracts. Legacy mode retains paint patterns; explicit source themes use global source SVG colors independent of Empty aliases. Private hashes/markers and native-only ARIA/layout guards are excluded.
